This topic is part of the AQA GCSE Geography specification.

The Challenge of Natural Hazards appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet The Challenge of Natural Hazards in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Challenge of Natural Hazards.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
